data.content_ref: inline:The target incorrectly identifies latent heat / evapotranspiration as the primary driver of the nocturnal UHI. On a clear, calm night, evapotranspiration is minimal because there is no solar radiation to drive it; the dominant mechanism is differential radiative cooling governed by the sky view factor (impeded in cities by tall buildings). The target's own countercondition acknowledges this risk, noting that sky view factor might dominate over moisture availability. The cited oasis analogy is disanalogous precisely because nighttime rural cooling is not actively driven by an evaporative moisture source. Consequently, the single mechanism proposed for cross-city variation (vegetation/irrigation) is secondary to urban geometry and thermal storage.
